info.title: WildCrane API
info.description: Workspaces and their members, and the tasks, reviews, workflows, artifacts and decisions in them, and the events they write. See cloud/endpoints.md for authentication, pagination, errors, idempotency and the compatibility promise.

get.summary: Daily task counts and run usage of a workspace

post.description: Owners only. The email must be one an account already signs in with; it joins as a member at once. Adding a member twice keeps one.

patch.description: Owners only. The workspace's creator stays an owner (`last_owner`).

delete.description: Owners remove anyone; anyone removes themself, which is leaving. From their next request they see nothing of the workspace. Its creator cannot leave (`last_owner`), and nobody leaves a personal workspace.

projects.description: The workspace's projects with a folder there

delete.description: Owners only (`owner_only`). Removes the workspace's folders on that computer; it claims none of the workspace's jobs until its owner places one of its projects there again. Ends its share with the workspace too.

delete.description: Owners only (`owner_only`). Deletes its tasks with it, stopping their runs, then its board files. `general` cannot be deleted.

get.description: The project's files under `projects/<id>/` and its workspace's shared memory under `memory/`, in the workspace's board. With `since`, the files changed after that `seq`, deletions as `content: null`; without, every file.

post.summary: Write what a Runner changed on the board
post.description: All or nothing; with `job`, only while the Runner holds it. A task's card moved to `.archive/` ends the task: `cancelled` with `rejected_reason` when `rejected: true`, else `done`. A changed `workflow:` sets the task's. It writes the project's files under `projects/<id>/` and the workspace's shared memory under `memory/`. A file whose `base_seq` is behind refuses the write as `version_conflict` (409), answering those files as they are now.

base_seq.description: The `seq` the file was read at; 0 for a new one.

409.description: Files moved on since they were read

post.summary: Import a local board's cards and files
post.description: Owners and members. Makes a task that does not run for each card, in order, into a project holding no task or only tasks imported from the same `board`; a card imported before answers its task. Writes the cards of new tasks and `files` (paths under `projects/<id>/` or the shared `memory/`); a shared memory file the workspace already has is kept and named in `kept`. Cards with `review` go on review.

board.description: Which board the cards come from.

ref.description: The card's number on the local board.

number.description: The number it expects in the project; one that is not the next refuses the call.

path.description: Its file under `todo/`, named by `number`; a group keeps its folder.

review.description: `true` asks to approve the plan; an object asks the card's own question.

next.description: The number the project's next task takes.

get.description: The agents of the workflows the project's board holds, built-ins first, and the board's own scheduled agents (`board`): each with the user's rule and, for a scheduled one, whether it is on and its cadence over the default, and its newest run.

stages.description: The approvals its previews make when a card chooses them all, from each one's `after`.

land.description: What runs, in order, once the last approval is in; empty: that approval ends the task.

rule.description: The user's rule for every card on this workflow; empty when none.

put.summary: Set an agent's rule or schedule
put.description: Written on the project's board, where each Runner reads it at its next pull: `rule` is added to the end of every run the agent does, and an empty one clears it; `schedule` switches a scheduled agent on or off and sets its cadence, `auto` or e.g. `30m`, `6h`, `1d at 09:30`. Owners and members.

post.description: Queues the agent's job on the project's Runner. `queued` is false while one already waits or runs.

put.description: Written on the project's board as `rules/workflows/<name>.md`, where each Runner reads it at its next pull: every card on the workflow is written to it. An empty rule clears it. Owners and members.

200.description: OK, the workflow as the agents list has it.

run.description: Hand the task to your Runner, which plans, revises and builds it with akb, stopping at each draft for review. Your request opens your chat on the task. Refused with `runner_removed` when the runtime's Runner was removed from the workspace.

Left out: yours, or with no folder of the project on any of yours, the first shared one online. A shared computer runs the task in its owner's folder on its owner's runtime.

triage.description: A triage item waiting to be sorted that this task is made of; it becomes `carded`. Its project when `project` is left out.

metadata.description: The card fields its first step writes into the card. `related` and `blocked_by` name tasks of the same project by key, id or number; with a blocker not yet `done` or `cancelled`, planning waits for it.

images.description: Pictures for the request (#2182): its first step puts them on the card.

content.description: Base64; about 4 MB across a message.

post.description: Copies the workflow. With `run`, the task is made even when the plan's running tasks are all in use: it waits `queued` and starts once one stops running. Without a project it goes to its workspace's `general`. Running tasks count against the plan of the workspace's creator.

post.description: Stops the running step of a `run` task, keeping its work; once its Runner has stopped, the task is `stopped`. A Runner not connected stops once it connects. A task with no running step is `conflict`.

post.description: Runs a stopped or failed `run` task's last step again on the computer that ran it (`resume.machine`), carrying on its work there; it waits while that computer is offline. A task that cannot be resumed is `conflict`, and one whose computer was removed from the workspace `runner_removed`. `machine` starts the last step afresh on another computer, one of the creator's or one shared with the workspace and online; with none, a step whose shared computer is no longer shared (`resume.available: false`) is `runner_unavailable`.

schedule.description: What the task runs once nothing blocks it; null clears it.

put.description: Saves over the task's card, kept as written but for `metadata.blocked_by` and `metadata.schedule`, which go into its frontmatter. A `base_version` behind the current one is `conflict`; an unclosed fence or a second `<!-- agent -->` is `bad_request`; a blocker naming no task of the project is `bad_request`. Moves the review's `revision` on while it is ready or sent back. When a task becomes `done` or `cancelled`, the cards it blocked, the cards naming it and its group root change as on a local board: "Dependencies and groups" in `cloud/endpoints.md`.

get.description: The diff of the commit the task landed as, asked of the computer it landed on each time. `503 machine_offline` when that computer is not connected or does not answer; `404 commit_gone` when it no longer has the commit; `404 not_found` when the task landed nothing.

get.description: What a Runner's rejection review reads before planning a task in the workspace.

post.description: Answers how many of each left the list; a rejection, dismissal or restore after this brings one back.

put.summary: Share a computer with the workspace
put.description: Its owner only: the caller's own computer holding one of the workspace's projects, else `not_found`; a personal workspace is `conflict`. Its members may then run tasks there, in the owner's folder and on the owner's runtime for that computer.

delete.description: Its owner only. The members' runs there stop now, their queued steps end `stopped`, and their tasks are no longer pinned there; the owner's own keep running. Removing the computer (`DELETE …/runners/{machine}`) or its owner leaving ends the share too.

bearer.description: A WildCrane sign-in token, or an API key (`wck_…`).

quota.description: With `quota_exceeded`: the plan limit that was reached.

prefix.description: The first characters of the key, to tell keys apart.

key.description: The key itself. Returned only here, once.

general.description: The workspace's built-in project `general`, where a task created without a project goes. It cannot be deleted.

placed.description: In a list: whether the project has a folder on your Runner's computer.

version.description: Moved on by every change; a task keeps the version it was created on.

files.description: The current version's files. Only in `GET /v1/workflows/{id}`.

names.description: A built-in's name in each language.

files.description: Path → text: `WORKFLOW.md` and each agent's folder, `agents/<name>/AGENT.md` and the files beside it, as on a board. Text files only; each at most 256 KB, 2 MB together.

workspace.description: The workspace it goes into; your personal workspace when left out.

WorkflowInput.description: Checked as akb reads a board: `WORKFLOW.md` frontmatter, each `AGENT.md`, and every agent a stage names present. `expertise`, `checkpoints` and `memory` are refused.

TaskDiff.description: A landed commit's changes, read from the computer it landed on. Cloud keeps none of it.

patch.description: The file's hunks in unified diff form; absent for a binary file and when `truncated`.

truncated.description: Past 256 KB in one file or 1 MB in all, only the file list and its line counts are sent.

landing.description: Where a built task's work landed: the commit, the branch checked out in the project, and the computer, named as it was when the task finished. Null when nothing was committed. Cloud never pushes it.

resume.description: Set while a stopped or failed `run` task can be resumed: the computer its work is on, where `POST /v1/tasks/{id}/resume` runs it.

available.description: False once that computer is no longer shared with the task's creator; resume names another `machine`.

key.description: The project’s prefix and the task’s number in it. Moving the task or changing the prefix gives a new key; the old one still finds the task.

project.description: Tasks filed without a project are in `general`.

workflow.description: The workflow version the task runs on.

context.description: A Workflow builder task’s: `workflow` is the workflow it changes, and once it is done, the one it saved; `created` is true when that one is new.

waiting_for_slot.description: True while a queued `run` task waits only because its plan's running tasks are all in use. It starts on its own once one stops running.

card_version.description: The card's revision, moved on by every save; null before the first.

created_by.description: The handle of who started it. Its jobs run on their Runner, and its alerts go to them.

run.description: The Runner's current step of a `run` task; null while none is waiting or running.

runner_connected.description: Whether the Runner on the step's computer is connected. A queued step waits for it; a stop waits for it too.

machine.description: The name of the computer the step runs on.

stopping.description: Stopped by `POST /v1/tasks/{id}/stop`, and not ended yet.

runner_removed.description: The queued step's computer was removed from the task's workspace; it waits until a project folder is placed there again.

job.description: The step's job; `GET /v1/runner/jobs/{id}/stream` streams its log while it runs, and `GET /v1/runner/jobs/{id}` reads it once ended.

runtime_name.description: The name of the runtime the step runs on.

step.description: What the step does: `refine` plans the card or makes the previews an approval starts, `implement` builds it, from the start when the task skips planning.

result.description: The agent's summary, once a `run` task is done.

last_job.description: The newest step's job of a `run` task; its log stays readable after it ends.

runtime.description: The runtime it was started on; null for Global default.

discussion.description: The discussion it was started from.

cancel_reason.description: Why it was cancelled, when the canceller said; the rejection the planner learns from.

cancelled_by.description: The handle of whoever cancelled it.

Review.description: The task's review: what is up for review, and how it stands. `status` is null until a draft is submitted.

revision.description: Moves on whenever what is under review changes; it never goes back.

options.description: Exactly one `approve: true`, except on a card question, which has none.

card_question.description: Set when the review asks the card's open question: its 1-based place in the card's `questions:`. Requesting changes answers it.

ReviewEvent.description: What a `review.*` event carries, and what changing the question answers.

phase.description: The phase it was created in.

content.description: Inline JSON, or null for a file.

url.description: Path to read the file through.

component.description: The component version that draws this version, pinned when it was written; null for a built-in type or when none was published.

parts.description: Set when the file is sent in parts: every part is `size` bytes but the last.

decided_by.description: `{ kind: reviewer, email, handle? }`, `{ kind: user, handle }` or `{ kind: api_key, id, name }`.

phase.description: The phase it was made in.

comment.description: Set on a `comment` alert: the reviewer's comment it is about.

data.description: The resource as it stands after the change.

next.description: Pass as `after` for the next page; null on the last.
Pass as `after` for the next page; null on the last.

Pass as `after` for the next page; null on the last.
Pass as `after` for the next page; null on the last.
Pass as `after` for the next page; null on the last.

version.description: The card file's `seq` on its project's board, as the task's `card_version`.

metadata.description: Includes `previews`, the preview agents the card chose; `stages`, how many approvals they make; and `phase`, the one the card is on, from 1.

phase.description: The phase it was made in.

author.description: `{ kind: reviewer, email, handle? }`, `{ kind: user, handle }` or `{ kind: api_key, id, name }`.

SharedReview.description: `decisions`, `comments` and `revisions` (every phase's) for a member or a guest only; a visitor without a role gets no review `status` either. `guests` for owners only.

role.description: `owner` and `member` are the task's workspace roles; `guest` is invited to the task. Null for a visitor on a `link` link, who only reads.

names.description: The name of each preview the card's body draws, by agent id; one with no name of its own is absent.

round.description: The 1-based approval the task's card is on.

rounds.description: How many approvals the task's card makes.

stages.description: Each approval's agents, from the previews the card chose and each one's `after`; empty before it chooses.

lands.description: Whether approving the last one leads to the build, or ends the task.

files.description: Path → text: `WORKFLOW.md` and each agent's folder, `agents/<name>/AGENT.md` and the files beside it, as on a board. Text files only; each at most 256 KB, 2 MB together.

TaskChat.description: One person's conversation with an agent on a task, run on the task creator's Runner.

image_names.description: The pictures sent with it, by name.

usage.description: The tokens of the job that wrote the reply: `input`, `cacheCreation`, `cacheRead`, `output`.

cost_usd.description: Its list-price estimate, for this reply alone; null when unknown.

duration_ms.description: From the job's dispatch to its end.

status.description: `queued` behind the task's other Runner jobs; `conflict` when the card was updated elsewhere. A failure stays until the next message.

job.description: The replying run's job, whose log `GET /v1/runner/jobs/{id}/stream` streams; null when idle.

runtime.description: The pick: one of your runtimes' ids, or `task` to follow the task's runtime.

id.description: `task` for the task's runtime, else one of yours.

name.description: Null for the task's runtime when you did not start the task.

default.description: Global default, whose name the app shows translated.

status.description: The connector on the task creator's Runner.

runtimes.description: The task's runtime first, then your others.

context.description: The session's context window, when the Runner reported one.

state.description: `replying` while a reply is on its way; `waiting_you` when the agent spoke last and the task waits for review.
`waiting_you` when the agent spoke last and an idea waits to be started.

host.description: With `external=1`: the app an external discussion is held in.

oneOf.description: A discussion with a message, listed until it had ideas and none waits to be started.

acceptance.description: How to tell it is done.

workflow.description: The workflow the task is started on.

task.description: The task it became; null until started.

Discussion.description: One person's conversation drafting ideas, run on their Runner.

title.description: The first idea's title, else the first message's start.

version.description: Moves on every change to its ideas.

external.description: Held in a Claude Code or Codex session (`POST /v1/discussions/external`).

host.description: The app an external discussion is held in.

image_names.description: The pictures sent with it, by name.

usage.description: The tokens of the job that wrote the reply: `input`, `cacheCreation`, `cacheRead`, `output`.

cost_usd.description: Its list-price estimate, for this reply alone; null when unknown.

duration_ms.description: From the job's dispatch to its end.

status.description: A failure stays until the next message.

job.description: The replying run's job, whose log `GET /v1/runner/jobs/{id}/stream` streams; null when idle.

runtime.description: The pick, one of your runtimes.

default.description: Global default, whose name the app shows translated.

context.description: The session's context window, when the Runner reported one.

ideas.description: At most 10; a discarded one is gone.

personal.description: Every account has one. It takes no other members, and cannot be left or deleted.

next.description: Pass as `after` for the next page; null on the last.
Pass as `after` for the next page; null on the last.

usage.description: Tokens of the runs that finished that day.

types.description: The artifact types it draws, each `@<your handle>/<name>`.

schema.description: A JSON Schema the content it saves must match.

url.description: The version's own origin on wildcraneusercontent.com, to frame.

installed.description: Whether the workspace has it installed.

workspace.description: A workspace id; your personal workspace when left out.

model.description: Left null, the connector's own default model.

runner.description: The Runner's machine id. Its jobs go to that computer only and wait while it is offline; null, or a computer no longer the account's Runner, until it is pointed at one.

settings.description: The connector's own settings beside the model, by the keys its harness declares (provider, endpoint, reasoning effort, extra arguments…). Never a key.

secretsSet.description: The keys the runtime's Runner reports holding, e.g. apiKey. The keys themselves are never sent back.

default.description: Global default: first in the list, never renamed or deleted, and what a task naming no runtime runs on.

connectors.description: Each connector as your Runner last reported it.

models.description: The models each connector offers on your Runner's computer, as it last reported them; a connector that reported none is left out.

connector_settings.description: What each connector takes on your Runner, as its harness declares it: what a form draws, never how it reaches a run.

message.description: What the connector said, when `result` is `failed`.

id.description: The item's project and file name; moving it never changes it.

project.description: Items filed without a project are in `general`.

workflow.description: The workflow that does its work; null on an item filed before it was asked for.

dismissed_by.description: The handle of whoever dismissed it.

task.description: The task made of it, once `carded`.

next.description: Pass as `after` for the next page; null on the last.

tasks.description: Tasks cancelled with a reason, oldest first, at most 100.

triage.description: Items dismissed, or restored after a dismissal was learned, oldest first, at most 100.
